name: long-horizon
description: Continuous Iterative Development (CID) for long-horizon projects: an autonomous loop of four fresh-context roles (update-state, define-next, advance, review) that advances a project in small verified increments toward a human-owned target, self-determines its phase (new/poc/mvp/stable), adjusts rigor per phase, and self-improves through a learnings ledger and retro passes
